question: What establishes the a/b deadlock, and why does the successful heartbeat not contradict it?

criteria.instruction: a holds C and waits for I held by b; b holds I and waits for C held by a. Both retain their first lock, forming a simultaneous cycle from refresh C-to-I versus compact I-to-C. The unrelated heartbeat can remain live while these workers block. Low CPU alone would not prove deadlock.
